dialog.about.title: About Sim Studio
dialog.about.body:
Sim Studio %1
Private production-line simulation, Phase 1.
Offline. No telemetry. No network calls at runtime.
Available: 3D viewport, assembly tree, STEP/OBJ import, project save.
Physics, robot kinematics, cycle time, and PLC commissioning come in later phases.
dialog.physics.title: Physics engine
dialog.physics.body:
Backend: %1
Phase 2 will attach NVIDIA PhysX 5 behind this interface for rigid bodies, joints, sensors, and conveyors. Nothing is simulated yet.
dialog.script.title: Scripting
dialog.script.body:
Backend: %1
Phase 2 will embed Python through pybind11, similar to MELSOFT Gemini / Visual Components, for device behavior and robot programs. There is no script runtime yet.
